  38class BrachyPlan:
  39    r"""
  40    ### Purpose:
  41    - This class holds the information regarding the brachytherapy treatment plan
  42    as well as all the functions to support the necessary plan operations.
  43
  44    ### Attributes:
  45
  46    #### Geometry and Structure Attributes:
  47    - phantom (BrachyPhantom): A BrachyPhantom object containing the patient geometry and structures.
  48    - structure_list (List[BrachyStructure]): A list of BrachyStructure objects containing the patient structures.
  49    - body_contour (ROIContour): The body contour of the patient.
  50    - phantom_origin (list): The origin of the phantom in the patient coordinate system.
  51    - organ_bounds (list): Min and max coordinates of the patient organs on each axis.
  52    - dvh_metric_goals (dict): Dictionary containing the DVH metric goals for the plan.
  53    - dvh_metrics_observed (dict): Dictionary containing the observed DVH metrics for the plan.
  54    - prescription_dose (float): The dose prescribed to the target volume.
  55
  56    #### Catheter and Dwell Position Attributes:
  57    - catheter_table (CatheterTable): A catheter table object containing the catheter information.
  58    - num_catheters (int): The number of catheters in the plan.
  59    - catheter_numbers (list): The catheter ID numbers for each catheter in the catheter table.
  60    - num_dwells (int): The total number of dwell positions along all catheters in the plan.
  61    - dwell_numbers (list): The dwell number ID of each dwell position in the plan.
  62    - dwell_times (List[float]): The dwell time for each dwell position in the plan.
  63    - dwell_coordinates (List[list]): The coordinates of each dwell position in patient coordinates.
  64
  65    #### Applicator Attributes:
  66    - applicator_list (List[BrachyApplicator]): The list of all applicators in the plan.
  67    - applicator_rotation_axis (np.array): The rotation axis of applicators (default: [0, 0, 1]).
  68    - applicator_rotation_origin (np.array): The rotation origin of applicators (default: [0, 0, 0]).
  69
  70    #### Dose Attributes:
  71    - dose_rate_dict (defaultdict[BrachyDose]): Dictionary holding 3D dose rate maps for each dwell position.
  72    - combined_dose (BrachyDose): Sum of the dose rate maps weighted by the dwell times.
  73
  74    #### Simulation and Optimization Attributes:
  75    - simulation_setup (BrachySimulation): A simulation setup object containing source info and simulation parameters.
  76    - optimization_config_list (List[Optimization_Config]): List of optimization configurations for the plan.
  77    """
  78
  79    def __init__(
  80        self,
  81        #### for geometry definition:
  82        phantom: Union[Path, BrachyPhantom, dict] = None,
  83        #### for structure creation:
  84        prescription_dose: float = None,
  85        strict_name_match: bool = True,
  86        #### for loading catheter table and/or applicators:
  87        catheter_table: Union[Path, CatheterTable, str] = None,
  88        applicator_pth_list: Union[Path, str, list] = None,
  89        #### for loading dose or uncertainty:
  90        combined_dose: Union[Path, str, BrachyDose] = None,
  91        dir_dose_rate: Path = None,
  92        #### for simulation setup:
  93        simulation_setup: dict | Path | str = None,
  94        #### for optimization setup:
  95        optimization_config_list:  List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str = None,
  96        **kwargs
  97    ):
  98        r"""
  99        ### Purpose:
 100        - To initialize the BrachyPlan object.
 101
 102        ### Inputs:
 103        #### For geometry definition:
 104        - phantom: Path|BrachyPhantom|dict := the phantom object, the path to the phantom directory,
 105        or a dictionary containing the paths. A phantom object can include structures as well. See load_phantom() for more info.
 106
 107        #### For Structure optimization and dosimetry
 108        - prescription_dose: float = None := The dose that is prescribed to the target volume. This is used to calculate the DVH metrics. 
 109
 110        #### for loading catheter table and applicators:
 111        - catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a json file containing the information of the catheter table.
 112        - applicator_pth_list := The list of applicator paths or the path to the json file containing the list. see load_applicator_list() for more info.
 113
 114        #### for loading dose rates or uncertainty maps per dwell position:
 115        - combined_dose: Path|BrachyDose := the path to the combined dose file or a BrachyDose object.
 116        - dir_dose_rate:str := path to the directory containing the dose rate files for a patient.
 117
 118        #### for simulation setup:
 119        - simulation_setup = None := dictionary containing the simulation setup,
 120        - load_uncertainty:bool := If True, the uncertainties of the dose rates are also loaded. 
 121        - multi_processing:bool :=  If True, 16 threads are used to load the dose rates simulatenously.
 122        - combined_dose_only:bool := If True, all the dose rates will be removed from memory after 
 123        combined dose is calculated.
 124        - dose_dtype:np.float32 := The floating point type to store the dose rates. 
 125
 126        #### Keywords Arguments:
 127        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True := if True, will only load the dwell positions that
 128        had non-zero dwell times in the DICOM plan file. If False, will load all the dwell positions
 129        from the digitization points.
 130        - dwells_near_ptv: bool = True := if True, will remove the dwell positions that are outside PTV
 131        with a margine of 10 mm.
 132        - add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False := if True, will add hotspot structures to the phantom.
 133        this is good for debugging, but slows down the plan creation process.
 134        - one_hotspot_structure: bool: = True := if False, will create separate hotspot structures
 135        - applicator_format:str = "RapidBrachy" := the format of the applicator list 
 136        (default is "RapidBrachy"). See load_applicator_list() for more info. 
 137        - load_uncertainty: bool := If true, it will the uncertainty of the dose rates as well.
 138        - dvh_metric_goals: List[str] | Dict[str, float] | Path | str := A list of all DVH metric
 139        names or the dictionary containing the DVH metric names and their goals or the path to its
 140        json file. Look at set_dvh_metric_goals for guideline on the names of the DVH metrics.
 141        The phantom should be loaded with structures for the Brachy stuctures to be created.
 142
 143        ### Outputs:
 144            - None := will initialize the BrachyPlan object
 145        """
 146        # declare the attributes
 147        # patient origin is used as a reference point for the catheter table,
 148        # the dwell coordinates, image origin, egsphant, and the dose objects.
 149
 150        # phantom and geometry attributes
 151        self.phantom: BrachyPhantom = None
 152        self.dvh_metric_goals: dict = None
 153        self.structure_list: List[BrachyStructure] = []
 154        self.body_contour: ROIContour = None
 155        self.phantom_origin: list = None  # np.array([0, 0, 0])  # x,y,z
 156        self.organ_bounds: list = None
 157
 158        # catheter table attributes
 159        self.catheter_table: CatheterTable = None
 160        self.num_catheters: int = None
 161        self.catheter_numbers:list = np.array([], dtype=int)  # shape: (num_catheters, 1)
 162        self.num_dwells: int = None
 163        self.dwell_numbers: list = np.array([], dtype=int)  # shape: (num_dwells, 1)
 164        self.dwell_times: List[float] = np.array([], dtype=np.float32)  # shape: (num_dwells, 1)
 165        self.dwell_coordinates: List[list] = []  # shape: (num_dwells, 3)
 166
 167        # applicator attributes
 168        self.applicator_list: List[BrachyApplicator] = []
 169        # XXX: figure out if the two below are dwell or applicator attributes?
 170        # they are dwell attributes that are impacted by applicator rotation. for now, leave them be.
 171        self.applicator_rotation_axis: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 1])  # x,y,z
 172        self.applicator_rotation_origin: float = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # x,y,z
 173
 174        # dose attributes
 175
 176        # simulation attributes
 177        self.simulation_setup: BrachySimulation = None
 178
 179        ## fill the attributes depending on the inputs to the constructor
 180        # set the dvh metric goals if provided
 181        self.prescription_dose = prescription_dose
 182        # load the dicom plan if the path is provided
 183        if phantom is not None:
 184            if isinstance(phantom, BrachyPhantom):
 185                self.phantom = phantom
 186            elif (
 187                isinstance(phantom, Path)
 188                or isinstance(phantom, str)
 189                or isinstance(phantom, dict)
 190            ):
 191                self.load_phantom(phantom)
 192            else:
 193                raise ValueError("phantom should be a BrachyPhantom object or a path")
 194        # create structures based on the phantom structures and DVH metric goals
 195        if self.phantom is not None:
 196            if self.phantom.structure_set is not None:
 197                self.set_brachy_structure_list(
 198                    phantom=self.phantom,
 199                )
 200
 201        if kwargs.get("dvh_metric_goals", None) is not None:
 202            dvh_metric_goals = kwargs.get("dvh_metric_goals")
 203            if self.prescription_dose is None:
 204                raise ValueError("prescription dose is not provided. Please provide it.")
 205            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, str) or isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, Path):
 206                dvh_metric_goals = Path(dvh_metric_goals)
 207                with open(dvh_metric_goals, "r") as json_file:
 208                    dvh_metric_goals = json.load(json_file)
 209            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, list):
 210                self.set_dvh_metric_goals(
 211                    dvh_metric_names=dvh_metric_goals,
 212                    strict_name_match=strict_name_match)
 213            elif isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, dict):
 214                self.set_dvh_metric_goals(
 215                    dvh_metric_goals=dvh_metric_goals,
 216                    strict_name_match=strict_name_match)
 217
 218        # load the catheter table if the path is provided
 219        if catheter_table is not None:
 220            self.set_catheter_table(
 221                catheter_table=catheter_table,
 222                from_delivered_dwellpositions=kwargs.get("from_delivered_dwellpositions", False),
 223                dwells_near_ptv=kwargs.get("dwells_near_ptv", True),
 224                )
 225        # load the dose rate dict if the path is provided
 226        if dir_dose_rate is not None and combined_dose is None:
 227            self.catheter_table.load_dose_rates(
 228                dir_dose_rate=dir_dose_rate,
 229                load_uncertainty=kwargs.get("load_uncertainty", False),
 230                multi_processing=kwargs.get("multi_processing", True),
 231                combined_dose_only=kwargs.get("combined_dose_only", False),
 232                dose_dtype=kwargs.get("dose_dtype", np.float32),
 233                )
 234        elif dir_dose_rate is None and combined_dose is not None:
 235            self.catheter_table.set_combined_dose(combined_dose)
 236        elif dir_dose_rate is not None and combined_dose is not None:
 237            raise ValueError(
 238                "invalid input. Please provide either dir_dose_rate or combined_dose but not both"
 239            )
 240        
 241        # # load the simulation setup if the dictionary is provided
 242        if simulation_setup is not None:
 243            if isinstance(simulation_setup, dict):
 244                self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
 245                    **simulation_setup
 246                )
 247            elif isinstance(simulation_setup, Path) or isinstance(
 248                simulation_setup, str
 249            ):
 250                # if json file, load the entire simulation dict from json file
 251                if str(simulation_setup).endswith(".json"):
 252                   self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
 253                    pth_simulation_setup=simulation_setup
 254                )
 255                # if dicom plan file, load the source from the dicom file
 256                # and assuming the catheter table is loaded from the same dicom file,
 257                # provide the total time from the catheter table
 258                elif str(simulation_setup).endswith(".dcm"):
 259                    self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
 260                        brachy_source=simulation_setup,
 261                        total_time=np.sum(self.dwell_times))
 262
 263        # load the applicator list if the path is provided
 264        if applicator_pth_list is not None and applicator_format is not None:
 265            self.load_applicator_list(
 266                applicator_pth_list, kwargs.get("applicator_format", "RapidBrachy"))
 267
 268        # # setup optimization
 269        if optimization_config_list is not None:
 270            self.optimization_config_list = optimization_config_list
 271            self.setup_optimization(
 272                self.optimization_config_list,
 273                self.structure_list,
 274                add_hotspots_to_phantom=kwargs.get("add_hotspots_to_phantom", False),
 275                one_hotspot_structure=kwargs.get("one_hotspot_structure", True),
 276            )
 277
 278    @computed_field
 279    def combined_dose(self):
 280        return self.catheter_table.combined_dose

 282    def load_phantom(self, pth_phantom: Union[Path, dict]):
 283        r"""
 284        ### Purpose:
 285        - To load phantom from file path into Brachy Plan. Not that if a directory is provided,
 286        it should have only one phantom file.
 287        ### Inputs:
 288        - pth_phantom:str := The phantom path could be a directory of DICOM files
 289        or a directory of NRRD files. In addition, it could be the path to a json
 290        file containing paths to specific phantom files. Look at the inputs of BrachPhantom
 291        for more information on the expected keys of the json file.
 292        ### Outputs:
 293        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.phantom attribute
 294        """
 295        os.path.exists(pth_phantom), f"phantom path does not exist: {pth_phantom}"
 296        # initialize the inputs to the BrachyPhantom object
 297        dir_dicom = None
 298        pth_phantom_file = None
 299        pth_structures_file = None
 300        pth_egsphant_file = None
 301        # if the paths are provided as a dictionary
 302        if isinstance(pth_phantom, dict):
 303            phantom_config = pth_phantom
 304            for key in phantom_config:
 305                if key == "dir_dicom":
 306                    dir_dicom = phantom_config.get(key)
 307                elif key == "pth_phantom_file":
 308                    pth_phantom_file = phantom_config.get(key)
 309                elif key == "pth_structures_file":
 310                    pth_structures_file = phantom_config.get(key)
 311                elif key == "pth_egsphant_file":
 312                    pth_egsphant_file = phantom_config.get(key)
 313        # check if the pth_phantom is a directory or a json file
 314        elif os.path.isdir(pth_phantom):
 315            print("loading phantom from directory")
 316            # check if the directory contains dicom files or nrrd files
 317            file_list = glob(os.path.join(pth_phantom, "*.dcm"))
 318            if len(file_list) > 0:
 319                dir_dicom = pth_phantom
 320                pth_structures_file = list(filter(lambda x: "RS" in x, file_list))[0]
 321            else:
 322                file_list = glob(os.path.join(pth_phantom, "*.nrrd"))
 323                if len(file_list) > 0:
 324                    for file_name in file_list:
 325                        if file_name.endswith(".seg.nrrd"):
 326                            pth_structures_file = file_name
 327                        elif file_name.endswith(".egsphant.nrrd"):
 328                            pth_egsphant_file = file_name
 329                        elif file_name.endswith(".nrrd"):
 330                            pth_phantom_file = file_name
 331                    if pth_egsphant_file is None:
 332                        pth_egsphant_file = glob(
 333                            os.path.join(pth_phantom, "ct.egsphant.nrrd")
 334                        )
 335                        if len(pth_egsphant_file) == 0:
 336                            pth_egsphant_file = None
 337                else:
 338                    raise ValueError(
 339                        "invalid directory. Please provide a directory containing dicom or nrrd files"
 340                    )
 341        else:
 342            assert (
 343                os.path.splitext(pth_phantom)[1] == ".json"
 344            ), "invalid file format. Please provide a json file"
 345            with open(pth_phantom, "r") as json_file:
 346                phantom_config = json.load(json_file)
 347            for key in phantom_config:
 348                if key == "dir_dicom":
 349                    dir_dicom = phantom_config.get(key)
 350                elif key == "pth_phantom_file":
 351                    pth_phantom_file = phantom_config.get(key)
 352                elif key == "pth_structures_file":
 353                    pth_structures_file = phantom_config.get(key)
 354                elif key == "pth_egsphant_file":
 355                    pth_egsphant_file = phantom_config.get(key)
 356
 357        # load the phantom
 358        self.phantom = BrachyPhantom(
 359            dir_dicom=dir_dicom,
 360            pth_phantom_file=pth_phantom_file,
 361            pth_structures_file=pth_structures_file,
 362            pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file,
 363        )
 364        self.phantom_origin = self.phantom.image_obj.origin
 365
 366    def set_catheter_table(
 367        self,
 368        catheter_table: Union[Path, CatheterTable],
 369        from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True,
 370        dwells_near_ptv: bool = True,):
 371        r"""
 372        ### Purpose:
 373        - To set the catheter table of the plan and update the plan attributes accordingly.
 374        ### Inputs:
 375        - catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a
 376        json file containing the information of the catheter table.
 377        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := Whether to load only the delivered dwell positions
 378        from the catheter table. Only applicable if the catheter table is loaded from a DICOM plan file. 
 379        If False, all the dwell positions from the digitization points will be loaded.
 380        - dwells_near_ptv: bool := Whether to remove dwells that are far from the PTV.
 381        ### Outputs:
 382        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.catheter_table attribute and all the related attributes
 383        such as dwell times, coordinates, etc.
 384        """
 385        if isinstance(catheter_table, (str, Path)):
 386            self.catheter_table = CatheterTable(
 387                catheters_dict=catheter_table,
 388                from_delivered_dwellpositions=from_delivered_dwellpositions,
 389                )
 390        elif isinstance(catheter_table, CatheterTable):
 391            if self.catheter_table is None:
 392                self.catheter_table = catheter_table
 393            else:
 394                self.catheter_table.merge(catheter_table)
 395        else:
 396            raise ValueError(
 397                "catheter_table should be a path or a CatheterTable object"
 398            )
 399        if dwells_near_ptv:
 400            for structure in self.structure_list:
 401                if structure.is_target:
 402                    if isinstance(structure.mask, ROIContour):
 403                        mask = structure.mask.getBinaryMask(
 404                            origin=self.phantom.image_obj.origin,
 405                            gridSize=self.phantom.image_obj.gridSize,
 406                            spacing=self.phantom.image_obj.spacing,
 407                        )
 408                    else:
 409                        mask = structure.mask
 410                    self.catheter_table.remove_outside_mask(
 411                        mask=mask,
 412                        margin_mm=5.0,
 413                    )
 414        self.update_plan_from_catheter_table(
 415            time_diffs=self.catheter_table._time_diffs)
 416
 417    def update_plan_from_catheter_table(self, time_diffs=None):
 418        r"""
 419        ### Purpose:
 420        - To extract the dwell numbers, times, and coordinates from the catheter table
 421        and save them as class attributes.
 422        ### Inputs:
 423        - self := the BrachyPlan object
 424        - time_diffs: dict := A dictionary of time differences for each dwell position. this is used for fast plan update.
 425        ### Outputs:
 426        - None := will update the self.dwell_numbers, self.dwell_times,
 427        and self.dwell_coordinates attributes
 428        """
 429
 430        assert self.catheter_table is not None, "catheter table is not loaded"
 431        # reset the dwell_numbers, dwell times, coordinates, and num dwells
 432        if time_diffs is None: #I think this code is deprecated and is bottlenecking our hackathon project
 433            (
 434                self.catheter_numbers,
 435                self.dwell_numbers,
 436                self.dwell_times,
 437                self.dwell_coordinates,
 438            ) = (
 439                np.array([], dtype=int),
 440                np.array([], dtype=int),
 441                np.array([], dtype=np.float32),
 442                [],
 443            )
 444            self.num_catheters = None
 445            self.num_dwells = None
 446
 447            # extract the attributes above from the catheter table
 448            dwell_counter = 1
 449            for catheter in self.catheter_table.catheters_list:
 450                self.catheter_numbers = np.append(self.catheter_numbers, catheter.index)
 451                for dwell in catheter.dwells:
 452                    self.dwell_numbers = np.append(self.dwell_numbers, dwell_counter)
 453                    self.dwell_times = np.append(self.dwell_times, dwell.time)
 454                    self.dwell_coordinates.append(
 455                        {
 456                            "angle": dwell.angle,
 457                            "position": dwell.position,
 458                            "rotation": dwell.rotation,
 459                            "relativePos": dwell.relativePos,
 460                            "catheter_index": catheter.index,
 461                            "dwell_index": dwell.index,
 462                        }
 463                    )
 464                    dwell_counter += 1
 465            assert (
 466                len(self.catheter_numbers) - 1 == self.catheter_numbers[-1]
 467            ), "catheter numbers are not extracted correctly"
 468            self.num_catheters = len(self.catheter_numbers)
 469            assert (
 470                len(self.dwell_numbers) == self.dwell_numbers[-1]
 471            ), "dwell numbers are not extracted correctly"
 472            self.num_dwells = len(self.dwell_numbers)
 473
 474    def set_dvh_metric_goals(
 475        self,
 476        dvh_metric_names: List[str] | Path = None,
 477        dvh_metric_goals: dict | Path = None,
 478        strict_name_match: bool = True
 479        ) -> None:
 480        r"""
 481        ### Purpose:
 482        - To set the dvh metric list of the BrachyPlan object and each of the BrachyStructures.
 483        You can provide either the dvh_metric_names or the dvh_metric_goals.
 484        ### Inputs:
 485        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
 486        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
 487        For example D95%(organName).
 488        - dvh_metric_goals:Dict[str, float] := a dictionary of DVH metrics and their clinical goals.
 489        The keys should be following the same convention as for dvh_metric_names.
 490        - strict_name_match: bool := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric
 491        goals should mask perfectly. Otherwise, the name of the structure in the DVH metric goals can be
 492        a substring of the name of the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".
 493        ### Outputs:
 494        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals attribute as well as 
 495        BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_names and BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_goals.
 496        The keys of the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals are:
 497        {
 498            BrachyStructure.name: {
 499                "dvh_metric_names: [list of the names for that structure],
 500                "dvh_metric_goals: {if applicable}
 501            }    
 502        }
 503        """
 504        if dvh_metric_names is not None and dvh_metric_goals is not None:
 505            raise ValueError("Please provide either dvh_metric_names or dvh_metric_goals, not both") 
 506
 507        if len(self.structure_list) == 0:
 508            raise ValueError("The plan structure set is empty, please run set_brachy_structure_list")
 509
 510        if isinstance(dvh_metric_names, Path):
 511            with open(dvh_metric_names, "r") as json_file:
 512                dvh_metric_names = json.load(json_file)
 513
 514        if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
 515            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, Path):
 516                with open(dvh_metric_goals, "r") as json_file:
 517                    dvh_metric_goals = json.load(json_file)
 518            dvh_metric_names = list(dvh_metric_goals.keys())
 519
 520        self.dvh_metric_goals = defaultdict(dict)
 521        # let's match the structure names in the DVH with the structure names
 522        # in the BrachyPlan.
 523        for brachy_structure in self.structure_list:
 524            # get all the dvh metrics for this structure
 525            structure_dvh_metrics_names = []
 526            for dvh_name in dvh_metric_names:
 527                structure_name_in_dvh = dvh_name.split("(")[-1].split(")")[0]
 528                if strict_name_match:
 529                    if brachy_structure.name == structure_name_in_dvh:
 530                        structure_dvh_metrics_names.append(dvh_name)
 531                    else:
 532                        continue
 533                else:
 534                    if structure_name_in_dvh in brachy_structure.name:
 535                        structure_dvh_metrics_names.append(dvh_name)
 536                    else:
 537                        continue
 538            self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
 539                "dvh_metric_names": structure_dvh_metrics_names
 540            }
 541            brachy_structure.set_dvh_metric_names(
 542                self.dvh_metric_goals.get(brachy_structure.name).get("dvh_metric_names")
 543            )
 544            if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
 545                self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
 546                        "dvh_metric_goals": {}}
 547                for dvh_name in structure_dvh_metrics_names:
 548                    self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
 549                        "dvh_metric_goals": {
 550                            dvh_name: dvh_metric_goals[dvh_name]
 551                        }
 552                    }
 553                brachy_structure.set_dvh_metric_goals(
 554                    self.dvh_metric_goals.get(brachy_structure.name).get("dvh_metric_goals")
 555                )
 556
 557    def set_brachy_structure_list(
 558        self,
 559        phantom: BrachyPhantom,
 560        mask_type: Union[ROIContour, ROIMask] = ROIContour,
 561        )->None:
 562        r"""
 563        ### Purpose:
 564        - To create a list of BrachyStructure objects from the structures in the phantom and
 565        the DVH metric goals. Each BrachyStructure object will have attributes for the structure
 566        contour, the DVH and uncertainty volume histograms, optimization attributes, and simulation attributes.
 567        ### Inputes:
 568        - phantom := the phantom with its structures fully loaded.
 569        - dvh_metric_goals := the dvh metric goals dictionary
 570        - mask_type: ROIContour | ROIMask := Phantom masks will be converted to this type when being
 571        stored in BrachySturucture.
 572        ### Outputs:
 573        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.structure_list attribute
 574        """
 575        self.structure_list = []
 576        if phantom.cached_structure_masks is not None:
 577            structure_masks = deepcopy(phantom.cached_structure_masks)
 578        else:
 579            structure_masks: dict = phantom.get_structure_mask(
 580                phantom.structure_names, mask_type,
 581            )
 582
 583        for structure_name in structure_masks.keys():
 584            structure_obj = BrachyStructure(
 585                name=structure_name,
 586                mask=structure_masks[structure_name],
 587                is_target=True if (
 588                    "ctv" in structure_name.lower()
 589                    or "ptv" in structure_name.lower())  else False,
 590            )
 591            self.structure_list.append(structure_obj)
 592        if phantom.cached_structure_masks is not None:
 593            body_key = None
 594            for k in phantom.cached_structure_masks.keys():
 595                if k.lower() == "body":
 596                    body_key = k
 597            self.body_contour = phantom.cached_structure_masks.get(body_key, None)
 598        else:
 599            self.body_contour = phantom.get_structure_mask(
 600                ["body"], ROIContour, strict_name_match=False
 601            ).get("body", None)
 602
 603    def load_applicator_list(
 604        self,
 605        applicator_list_pth: Union[list, Path, str],
 606        format: Literal["WebApp", "RapidBrachy"] = "WebApp",
 607    ):
 608        r"""
 609        ### Purpose:
 610        - To load the applicator list from a json file containing the applicator geometry.
 611        ### Inputs:
 612        - applicator_list_pth:str := path to the json file containing the applicator list with N applicators.
 613        The items inside this list have the attributes bellow. If any left empty, the default value will be used.
 614        these attributes could be changed later using the setter functions.
 615
 616        if the format is WebApp, the attributes are:
 617            - "path": path to the applicator geometry file (.stl or .json).
 618            - "material": material of the applicator (str).
 619            - "density": density of the applicator (str).
 620            - "origin": origin of the applicator ([x,y,z]).
 621            - "rotation": rotation of the applicator ([w,x,y,z]).
 622            - "rotation_origin": origin of the rotation ([x,y,z]).
 623            - "coordinates": coordinates of the applicator ([x,y,z]).
 624
 625        if the format is RapidBrachy, the attributes are:
 626            - "densities": list of densities of the applicator.
 627            - "filenames": list of filenames of the applicator.
 628            - "materials": list of materials of the applicator.
 629            - "points": list of points (x,y,z,x,y,z) describing the first and last dwell positions
 630            on the applicator in the frame of the applicator.
 631            - "shieldNormalx": normal of applicator in the x direction in the frame of CT.
 632            - "shieldNormaly": normal of applicator in the y direction in the frame of CT.
 633            - "shieldNormalz": normal of applicator in the z direction in the frame of CT.
 634            - "wRot": list of wRot of the applicator.
 635            - "x": list of x of the applicator.
 636            - "xRoti": list of xRot of the applicator i in [1, N].
 637            - "y": list of y of the applicator.
 638            - "yRoti": list of yRot of the applicator i in [1, N].
 639            - "z": list of z of the applicator.
 640            - "zRoti": list of zRot of the applicator i in [1, N].
 641
 642        - format:str := the format of the applicator geometry file. options are "RapidBrachy" or "WebApp"
 643        ### Outputs:
 644            - None := will update the BrachyPlan.applicator_list attribute
 645        """
 646        if isinstance(applicator_list_pth, Path) or isinstance(
 647            applicator_list_pth, str
 648        ):
 649            with open(applicator_list_pth, "r") as json_file:
 650                applicator_list = json.load(json_file)
 651        if format == "RapidBrachy":
 652            num_applicators = len(applicator_list["densities"])
 653
 654            for i in range(num_applicators):
 655
 656                j = i + 1 if i >= 1 else ""
 657                shieldNormal = np.array(
 658                    [
 659                        (
 660                            applicator_list["shieldNormalx"]
 661                            if "shieldNormalx" in applicator_list
 662                            else 0
 663                        ),
 664                        (
 665                            applicator_list["shieldNormaly"]
 666                            if "shieldNormaly" in applicator_list
 667                            else 0
 668                        ),
 669                        (
 670                            applicator_list["shieldNormalz"]
 671                            if "shieldNormalz" in applicator_list
 672                            else 0
 673                        ),
 674                    ]
 675                )
 676
 677                rotation = np.array(
 678                    [
 679                        (
 680                            applicator_list[f"wRot{j}"]
 681                            if f"wRot{j}" in applicator_list
 682                            else 0
 683                        ),
 684                        (
 685                            applicator_list[f"xRot{j}"]
 686                            if f"xRot{j}" in applicator_list
 687                            else 0
 688                        ),
 689                        (
 690                            applicator_list[f"yRot{j}"]
 691                            if f"yRot{j}" in applicator_list
 692                            else 0
 693                        ),
 694                        (
 695                            applicator_list[f"zRot{j}"]
 696                            if f"zRot{j}" in applicator_list
 697                            else 0
 698                        ),
 699                    ]
 700                )
 701
 702                applicator_obj = BrachyApplicator(
 703                    pth_input_file=applicator_list["filenames"][i],
 704                    material=applicator_list["materials"][i],
 705                    density=applicator_list["densities"][i],
 706                    origin=self.patient_origin,
 707                    rotation=rotation,
 708                    rotation_origin=np.array(
 709                        [
 710                            applicator_list["x"],
 711                            applicator_list["y"],
 712                            applicator_list["z"],
 713                        ]
 714                    ),
 715                    coordinates=np.array(
 716                        [
 717                            applicator_list["x"],
 718                            applicator_list["y"],
 719                            applicator_list["z"],
 720                        ]
 721                    ),
 722                    normal=shieldNormal,
 723                    # for now RapidBrachy exports only one catheter trajectory.
 724                    # in future, more catheter trajectories may be possible.
 725                    # use i instead of 0 to get the ith catheter trajectory.
 726                    catheter_trajectory=np.array(
 727                        [
 728                            applicator_list["points"][0][0:3],
 729                            applicator_list["points"][0][3:6],
 730                        ]
 731                    ),
 732                )
 733
 734                self.applicator_list.append(applicator_obj)
 735
 736        elif format == "WebApp":
 737            for applicator in applicator_list:
 738
 739                applicator_obj = BrachyApplicator(
 740                    pth_input_file=applicator["path"] if "path" in applicator else None,
 741                    material=(
 742                        applicator["material"] if "material" in applicator else None
 743                    ),
 744                    density=applicator["density"] if "density" in applicator else None,
 745                    origin=applicator["origin"] if "origin" in applicator else None,
 746                    rotation=(
 747                        applicator["rotation"] if "rotation" in applicator else None
 748                    ),
 749                    rotation_origin=(
 750                        applicator["rotation_origin"]
 751                        if "rotation_origin" in applicator
 752                        else None
 753                    ),
 754                    coordinates=(
 755                        applicator["coordinates"]
 756                        if "coordinates" in applicator
 757                        else None
 758                    ),
 759                    normal=applicator["normal"] if "normal" in applicator else None,
 760                    catheter_trajectory=(
 761                        applicator["catheter_trajectory"]
 762                        if "catheter_trajectory" in applicator
 763                        else None
 764                    ),
 765                )
 766                self.applicator_list.append(applicator_obj)
 767        else:
 768            raise ValueError("format should be either 'RapidBrachy' or 'WebApp'")
 769
 770    def get_dvh_metrics(
 771        self,
 772        combined_dose: BrachyDose=None,
 773        prescription_dose: float = None,
 774        return_percentage: bool = True,
 775        ) -> dict:
 776        r"""
 777        ### Purpose:
 778        - To get the observed value of the dvh metric for each structure in the BrachyPlan.
 779        the observed value is calculated from the combined dose map.
 780        ### Inputs:
 781        - self := the BrachyPlan object
 782        ### Outputs:
 783        - dvh_metrics_observed: a dictionary mapping every DVH metric to its observed value.
 784        """
 785        assert self.structure_list is not None, "structure list is not created yet"
 786        assert self.prescription_dose is not None, "prescription dose is not set"
 787        assert self.dvh_metric_goals is not None, "DVH metrics are not set, please run set_dvh_metric_goals()"
 788        if combined_dose is None:
 789            combined_dose = self.combined_dose
 790        if prescription_dose is None:
 791            prescription_dose = self.prescription_dose
 792        dvh_metrics_observed = {}
 793        for structure_obj in self.structure_list:
 794            if "hotspot_estimator" in structure_obj.name.lower():
 795                continue
 796            if not any(structure_obj.dvh_metric_names):
 797                continue
 798            observed_metrics = structure_obj.get_dvh_metric(
 799                combined_dose,
 800                prescription_dose,
 801                return_percentage,
 802                self.body_contour,
 803                )
 804            dvh_metrics_observed.update(observed_metrics)
 805        return dvh_metrics_observed
 806
 807    def export_dvh_metrics(self, output_pth: Union[str, Path]):
 808        r"""
 809        ### Purpose:
 810        - To export the dvh metrics of the BrachyPlan to a json file.
 811        ### Inputs:
 812        - output_pth := path to the output json file
 813        ### Outputs:
 814        - None := will export the dvh metrics to a json file
 815        """
 816        assert self.dvh_metrics_observed is not None, "dvh metrics are not calculated yet"
 817        assert output_pth.endswith(".json"), "output path should be a json file"
 818        with open(output_pth, "w") as json_file:
 819            json.dump(self.dvh_metrics_observed, json_file, indent=4)

 835    def calculate_uncertainty_per_structure(self):
 836        r"""
 837        ### Purpose:
 838        - To calculate the uncertainty of each structure in the BrachyPlan.
 839        ### Inputs:
 840        - self := the BrachyPlan object
 841        ### Outputs:
 842        - None := will update the BrachyStructure.uncertainty attribute
 843        """
 844        assert (
 845            self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image is not None
 846        ), "combined uncertainty is not calculated yet"
 847        assert self.structure_list is not None, "structure list is not created yet"
 848        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
 849            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
 850        )
 851
 852        for structure_obj in self.structure_list:
 853            # resample the uncertainty image on the structure
 854            structure_mask = structure_obj.mask.getBinaryMask(
 855                origin=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.origin,
 856                spacing=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.spacing,
 857                gridSize=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.gridSize
 858            )
 859            masked_uncertainty = self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray * structure_mask.imageArray
 860
 861            # isolate the uncertainty values that are in the mask
 862            flattened_uncertainty = masked_uncertainty.flatten()
 863            # generate a histogram from the masked uncertainty
 864            histogram, bins_edges = np.histogram(
 865                flattened_uncertainty,
 866                bins=100,
 867                range=(0, flattened_uncertainty.max() + 0.1),
 868            )
 869            structure_obj.uvh = histogram * np.prod(self.combined_dose.dose_image.spacing)
 870            structure_obj.uncertainty_mean = np.mean(flattened_uncertainty)
 871            structure_obj.uncertainty_std = np.std(flattened_uncertainty)
 872            structure_obj.uncertainty_max = np.max(flattened_uncertainty)
 873            structure_obj.uncertainty_min = np.min(flattened_uncertainty)
 874
 875    def export_brachy_plan(
 876        self,
 877        content_to_export: ExportConfig_BrachyPlan | dict,
 878        ):
 879        r"""
 880        ### Purpose:
 881        - To export the brachytherapy treatment plan and its components to files based on the
 882        provided export configuration. Supports exporting dose, catheter tables, plan files,
 883        simulation macros, egsphant files, applicator geometries, and structure sets.
 884
 885        ### Inputs:
 886        - content_to_export := ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object or dictionary containing export
 887        configuration. If a dictionary is provided, it will be converted to an ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object.
 888        
 889        The configuration object/dictionary should contain:
 890            - dir_export (Path): Directory where exported files will be written.
 891            - export_config_dose (ExportConfig_Dose|None): Dose export configuration.
 892            - export_config_cathetertable (ExportConfig_CatheterTable|None): Catheter table export configuration.
 893            - export_config_plan_and_mac (ExportConfig_PlanAndMac|None): Plan and Mac file export configuration.
 894            - export_config_egsphant (ExportConfig_Egsphant|None): Egsphant file export configuration.
 895            - applicator_geometry (bool): Whether to export applicator geometry.
 896            - structure_set (bool): Whether to export structure set.
 897
 898        ### Outputs:
 899        - None := Exported files are written to the directory specified in content_to_export.dir_export.
 900        The function conditionally exports the following file types based on configuration:
 901            - Dose files (combined dose and optionally dose rate maps)
 902            - Catheter table (.json or .mrk.json)
 903            - Plan files (.plan files for each dwell position)
 904            - Macro files (.mac simulation files)
 905            - Egsphant phantom file (ct.egsphant)
 906            - Applicator geometry files (applicator_geometry.json and .mac files)
 907            - Structure set file (structure_set.json)
 908
 909        ### Dependencies:
 910        - ExportConfig_BrachyPlan
 911        - export_dose()
 912        - export_catheter_table()
 913        - export_plan_files()
 914        - export_mac_files()
 915        - _export_egsphant()
 916        - _export_applicator_geometry()
 917        - _export_structure_set()
 918
 919        ### Example of content_to_export dict:
 920        ```python
 921        EXPORT_CONFIG = {
 922            "dir_export": "/path/to/export/directory",
 923            "export_config_dose": {
 924                "name_combined": "combined",
 925                "write_dose_rate_maps": False,
 926                "multi_processing": True
 927            },
 928            "export_config_cathetertable": {
 929                "name": "catheter_table",
 930                "remove_text": True,
 931                "one_markup_per_catheter": False
 932            },
 933            "export_config_egsphant": {
 934                "name": "egsphant",
 935                "assign_material_from_ct": False,
 936                "strict_name_match": False
 937            },
 938            "export_config_plan_and_mac": {
 939                "combined_only": True,
 940                "name_combined": "combined",
 941                "body_name_stl": "BODY"
 942            },
 943            "applicator_geometry": False,
 944            "structure_set": False
 945        }
 946        ```
 947        """
 948        if isinstance(content_to_export, dict):
 949            content_to_export = ExportConfig_BrachyPlan(**content_to_export)
 950        dir_export = content_to_export.dir_export
 951        dir_export.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 952
 953        if content_to_export.export_config_dose:
 954            self.catheter_table.export_dose(content_to_export.export_config_dose)
 955
 956        if content_to_export.export_config_cathetertable:
 957            self.export_catheter_table(
 958                export_config_cathetertable=content_to_export.export_config_cathetertable,
 959                catheter_table=self.catheter_table,
 960            )            
 961
 962        if content_to_export.export_config_plan_and_mac:
 963            self.export_plan_files(
 964                export_config_plan_and_mac=content_to_export.export_config_plan_and_mac,
 965                catheter_table=self.catheter_table,
 966                )
 967            self.export_mac_files(
 968                export_config_plan_and_mac=content_to_export.export_config_plan_and_mac,
 969                catheter_table=self.catheter_table
 970                )
 971
 972        if content_to_export.export_config_egsphant:
 973            self._export_egsphant(
 974                export_config_egsphant=content_to_export.export_config_egsphant
 975            )
 976
 977        if content_to_export.applicator_geometry:
 978            self._export_applicator_geometry(str(content_to_export.dir_export))
 979
 980        if content_to_export.structure_set:
 981            self._export_structure_set(
 982                str(dir_export), content_to_export.get("materials_table", None)
 983            )
 984
 985    def export_catheter_table(
 986        self,
 987        export_config_cathetertable: ExportConfig_CatheterTable,
 988        catheter_table: CatheterTable,
 989        ):
 990        r"""
 991        ### Purpose:
 992        - to export the catheter table to a given directory in mrk.json or .json format.
 993        ### Inputs:
 994        - export_config_cathetertable: The catheter table export configuration. Look at ExportConfig_CatheterTable for more info
 995        - catheter_table: The catheter table to export.
 996        ### Outputs:
 997        - None := will export the catheter table into the specified export directory.
 998        """
 999        if export_config_cathetertable.file_extension == "mrk.json":
1000            catheter_table.write_to_slicer_markup(
1001                pth_mrk_json=export_config_cathetertable.pth_catheter_table,
1002                remove_text=export_config_cathetertable.remove_text,
1003                one_markup_per_catheter=export_config_cathetertable.one_markup_per_catheter,
1004            )
1005        elif export_config_cathetertable.file_extension == ".json":
1006            catheter_table.write_json(
1007                export_config_cathetertable.dir_export
1008            )
1009
1010    def export_plan_files(
1011        self,
1012        export_config_plan_and_mac:ExportConfig_PlanAndMac,
1013        catheter_table:CatheterTable,
1014        ):
1015        r"""
1016        ### Purpose:
1017        - To export dwell positions and their normalized times into ".plan" text files in the
1018        format required by RapidBrachy.
1019        ### Inputs:
1020        - export_config_plan_and_mac = The export configuration for the plan files. see ExportConfig_PlanAndMac
1021        - catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.
1022        ### Outputs:
1023        - None := Two types of .plan files are written, one named combined.plan and the other
1024        named run_{dwellNumber}.plan. combined.plan contains info of all dwell positions and
1025        their normalized dwell time, and the run_{dwellNumber}.plan contains info of a single
1026        dwell position. The format of each .plan file is given in this example:
1027            "Treatment Plan
1028            56 Control Points
1029            Control Point
1030            weight = 0.00327228
1031            1 Dwell Position
1032            -10.2819,82.598,-1224.98,-0.0291444,-0.017922,0.999415,0,0,0,1,0,0,0
1033            Control Point ..."
1034        ### Dependencies:
1035            - None
1036        """
1037        # total_dwell_time = np.sum(self.dwell_times)
1038        cath_table_dose_gen = catheter_table.get_catheters_for_dose_gen()
1039        total_dwell_time = cath_table_dose_gen.treatment_time
1040        num_dwells = cath_table_dose_gen.num_dwell_positions
1041        combined_plan = "Treatment Plan\n"
1042        combined_plan += f"{num_dwells} Control Points\n"
1043
1044        for cat in catheter_table:
1045            # skip if no need to export for dose rate calculation
1046            if not cat.gen_dose_rates:
1047                continue
1048            for dwell in cat.dwells:
1049                dwell_coordinates_str = np.array(
1050                    list(dwell.position)
1051                    + list(dwell.rotation)
1052                    + [dwell.angle]
1053                    + list(self.applicator_rotation_axis)
1054                    + list(self.applicator_rotation_origin),
1055                    dtype=np.float32,
1056                )
1057                dwell_coordinates_str = (
1058                    ",".join(
1059                        [
1060                            str(int(coord)) if coord == int(coord) else format(coord, ".6f")
1061                            for coord in dwell_coordinates_str
1062                        ]
1063                    )
1064                    + "\n"
1065                )
1066
1067                catheter_idx = cat.index
1068                dwell_idx = dwell.index
1069                combined_plan += "Control Point\n"
1070                combined_plan += f"weight = {dwell.time/total_dwell_time}\n"
1071                combined_plan += f"1 Dwell Position - Catheter {catheter_idx + 1}\n"
1072                combined_plan += dwell_coordinates_str
1073
1074                run_i_plan = "Treatment Plan\n"
1075                run_i_plan += "1 Control Points\n"
1076                run_i_plan += "Control Point\nweight = 1.0\n"
1077                run_i_plan += "1 Dwell Position\n"
1078                run_i_plan += dwell_coordinates_str
1079                # Not dealing with shield angle for now but the new convention for filename is
1080                # xxx_catheter#_dwell#_shieldangle.plan
1081                shield_angle = 0
1082                if not export_config_plan_and_mac.combined_only:
1083                    order = f"{catheter_idx + 1}_{dwell_idx + 1}_{shield_angle}"
1084                    with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.dir_export / f"dwell_{order}.plan", "w") as file:
1085                        file.write(run_i_plan)
1086            # set to false so that we don't export the same catheter again for dose rate calculation
1087            cat.gen_dose_rates = False
1088        with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_plan_combined, "w") as file:
1089            file.write(combined_plan)
1090        print(".plan files were exported successfully")
1091
1092    def export_mac_files(
1093        self,
1094        export_config_plan_and_mac: ExportConfig_PlanAndMac,
1095        catheter_table:CatheterTable,
1096        ):
1097        r"""
1098        ### Purpose:
1099        - To export the simulation parameters of the plan into a macro files
1100        and run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac
1101        ### Inputs:
1102        - export_config_plan_and_mac:= The export configuration for macro files.
1103        - catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.
1104        ### Outputs:
1105        - None := Two types of .mac files are written, one named combined.mac and the other
1106        named run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac. combined.plan contains
1107
1108        plan contains info of a single dwell position.
1109
1110        The format of each .mac file is given in this example:
1111            /source_world/treatmentType HDR
1112            /source_world/switch MicroSelectronV2
1113            /source_world/coreMaterial G4_Ir
1114            /source_world/core/A 192
1115            /source_world/core/Z 77
1116            /sim/plan combined.plan
1117            /world/phantom ct.egsphant
1118            /parallel_world/ak_per_history 1.149000e-11
1119            /parallel_world/ref_ak 4.278729e+04
1120            /parallel_world/H 2.500000e+00
1121            /parallel_world/total_time 4.531841e+02
1122            /dose/format 3ddose
1123            /run/numberOfThreads 40
1124            /run/initialize
1125            /control/verbose 0
1126            /run/verbose 0
1127            /tracking/verbose 0
1128            /run/printProgress 1000000
1129            /sim/beamOn 10000000
1130        ### Dependencies:
1131        - simulation_utils
1132        """
1133        sim_obj = deepcopy(self.simulation_setup)
1134        sim_obj.total_time = catheter_table.treatment_time
1135        sim_obj.pth_plan = export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_plan_combined
1136        sim_obj.pth_phantom = export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_phantom
1137
1138        potential_stl = export_config_plan_and_mac.dir_export / "BODY.stl"
1139        if potential_stl.exists():
1140            # If RapidBrachyMC expects just the filename:
1141            sim_obj.pth_body_stl = "BODY.stl" 
1142            sim_obj.body_material = "Water"
1143        
1144        with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.pth_mac_combined, "w") as file:
1145            file.write(sim_obj.to_string())
1146
1147        if not export_config_plan_and_mac.combined_only:
1148            for cat in catheter_table:
1149                for dwell in cat.dwells:
1150                    catheter_idx = cat.index
1151                    dwell_idx = dwell.index
1152                    # Not dealing with shield angle for now but the new convention for filename is
1153                    # xxx_catheter#_dwell#_shieldangle.plan
1154                    shield_angle = 0
1155                    sim_obj = deepcopy(self.simulation_setup)
1156                    order = f"{catheter_idx + 1}_{dwell_idx + 1}_{shield_angle}"
1157                    sim_obj.pth_plan = f"dwell_{order}.plan"
1158                    sim_obj.total_time = 1
1159
1160                    with open(export_config_plan_and_mac.dir_export / f"run_{order}.mac", "w") as file:
1161                        file.write(sim_obj.to_string())
1162        print(".mac files were exported successfully")

1203    def _export_applicator_geometry(
1204        self, dir_export: str, export_format: str = "RapidBrachy"
1205    ):
1206        r"""
1207        ### Purpose:
1208        - To export the applicator geometries either in the RapidBrachy Format (mac files and single json file)
1209        or in webapp format (json file).
1210        ### Inputs:
1211        - dir_export := path to the directory where the export happens
1212        - format := the format of the applicator geometry file. options are "RapidBrachy" or "WebApp"
1213        ### Outputs:
1214        - None := will export the applicator geometries into the specified export directory.
1215        ### Dependencies:
1216        - None
1217        """
1218        if export_format == "RapidBrachy":
1219
1220            # initialize the fields of the json file:
1221            out_json = {
1222                "densities": [],
1223                "filenames": [],
1224                "materials": [],
1225                "points": [],
1226                "shieldNormalx": 0,
1227                "shieldNormaly": 0,
1228                "shieldNormalz": 0,
1229                "wRot": 0,
1230                "x": 0,
1231                "xRot": 0,
1232                "y": 0,
1233                "yRot": 0,
1234                "z": 0,
1235                "zRot": 0,
1236            }
1237            counter = 0
1238            for applicator in self.applicator_list:
1239
1240                out_json["densities"].append(applicator.density)
1241                out_json["filenames"].append(applicator.path)
1242                out_json["materials"].append(applicator.material)
1243                out_json["points"].append(
1244                    applicator.catheter_trajectory.flatten().tolist()
1245                )
1246                out_json["shieldNormalx"] = float(applicator.normal[0])
1247                out_json["shieldNormaly"] = float(applicator.normal[1])
1248                out_json["shieldNormalz"] = float(applicator.normal[2])
1249
1250                subscript = counter + 1 if counter >= 1 else ""
1251                out_json[f"wRot{subscript}"] = float(applicator.rotation[0])
1252                out_json[f"xRot{subscript}"] = float(applicator.rotation[1])
1253                out_json[f"yRot{subscript}"] = float(applicator.rotation[2])
1254                out_json[f"zRot{subscript}"] = float(applicator.rotation[3])
1255
1256                out_json["x"] = float(applicator.coordinates[0])
1257                out_json["y"] = float(applicator.coordinates[1])
1258                out_json["z"] = float(applicator.coordinates[2])
1259                counter += 1
1260
1261            with open(dir_export + "/applicator_geometry.json", "w") as file:
1262                json.dump(out_json, file, indent=4)
1263
1264        elif export_format == "WebApp":
1265            out_json = [
1266                applicator.to_dict(format) for applicator in self.applicator_list
1267            ]
1268            with open(dir_export + "/applicator_geometry.json", "w") as file:
1269                json.dump(out_json, file, indent=4)
1270
1271        else:
1272            raise ValueError("format should be either 'RapidBrachy' or 'WebApp'")
1273
1274        # export the mac files for each applicator
1275        for applicator in self.applicator_list:
1276            applicator.to_mac(os.path.join(dir_export, f"{applicator.name}.mac"))
1277        print("applicator geometry file was exported successfully")
1278
1279    def _export_structure_set(
1280        self,
1281        dir_export: str,
1282        materials_table: Union[dict, Path] = None,
1283    ):
1284        r"""
1285        ### Purpose:
1286        - to export the structure set of the plan into dir_export
1287        ### Inputs:
1288        - dir_export := path to the directory where the export happens
1289        - material_table: dict | Path := the dictionary of the materials. if Path, the path to the material file.
1290        The dictionary contains the name of the elements for each voxel,
1291        and the following keys: [
1292            "density" := the density of the material in g/cm^3,
1293            "HU_limit" := the lower HU limit threshold of the material,
1294            "structure_name := {optional} the name of the structure in the dicom file that represents the material,"
1295        ]
1296        ### Outputs:
1297        - None := self.structure_list is exported as a dictionary and
1298        written to structure_set.json
1299        ### Dependencies:
1300        """
1301        raise NotImplementedError("now that you are here, finish this function thank you!")
1302        structure_set = []
1303        for structure in self.structure_list:
1304            structure_set.append(structure.to_dict(export_format))
1305
1306            if materials_table is not None:
1307                from brachyutils.geometry.egsphant_utils import _load_material_dict
1308
1309                material_dict = _load_material_dict(materials_table)
1310                for material in material_dict:
1311                    if (
1312                        material_dict[material].get("structure_name", "")
1313                        == structure.name
1314                    ):
1315                        structure_set[-1]["density"] = material_dict[material][
1316                            "density"
1317                        ]
1318
1319        file_path = os.path.join(dir_export, "structure_set.json")
1320        with open(file_path, "w") as file:
1321            json.dump(structure_set, file, indent=4)
1322        print("structure set file was exported successfully")
